_comment: Provider-metadata fixture for scenario v2-pr-context-08. The harness supplies this file's content to the reviewer as environment context (in place of a live PR), so the scenario is reproducible without network access. PR #42 does not exist on any real provider by design.
title: Add discount + invoice line amounts
body: total() must skip a line that has no price key instead of raising. apply_discount(t, pct) must raise ValueError when pct is outside 0-100. Also refresh invoice line formatting and tests.
